support-rami: Customer reported bursts of 502/504s on Hosted API beginning ~22:10 PST. Happening on embeddings & generation routes, mostly during large batch requests. They see spikes correlated with billing writeback attempts :grimacing:
ashley: Any trace IDs or sample requests?
support-rami: Pasted curl and trace id from customer (scrubbed):
```
curl -v -H \"Authorization: Bearer ****\" \
  -H \"Content-Type: application/json\" \
  -d '{\"model\":\"redwood-embed-1\",\"input\":[...1000 items...]}' \
  https://api.redwood.inference/v1/embeddings
```
trace_id: 01-4f8b2a-9f3c3e7a-00000000

mike_sre: I see matching edge logs for that trace: Envoy reported upstream premature close and HTTP/2 RST_STREAM around same time. Sample snippet: 
```
[edge-proxy] trace=01-4f8b2a conn=keepalive pool_id=auth-upstream error=upstream_close_before_response
```
ashley: Is auth returning 200s? billing backend timeouts?
support-rami: Customer says auth calls succeed, but we have increased 502s when billing writeback happens right after inference. Could be fanout to billing backend causing head-of-line blocking.
sre-bot: Alert: edge-502-rate > threshold on frontdoor-prod-us-west for 15m. Top 5 upstreams: auth-cache(47%), billing-writes(29%), model-router(10%)
devex-julia: Quick repro steps I've been running: send a 750-item batch embed request, then simultaneously POST to /billing/events for the same user -> triggers 502s in ~30-60s window. Reduced batch size to 100 removes the 502s.
mike_sre: Hypothesis: L7 proxy per-connection concurrency + auth/billing synchronous post is exhausting h2 stream/window, causing upstream resets. Also auth cache TTL eviction may cause burst of auth upstream calls.
eng-oncall: Oncall taking this. First mitigation: enable tenant fallback routing (route to warm pool) for affected tenant and throttle billing writeback to async retry. Also enable streaming chunking on large embed requests.
ashley: Can support provide recommended workaround to customer?
support-rami: Sent back: please reduce embedding batch size to <=128 and enable client-side retries with exponential backoff. We're enabling async billing writes on our side as hotfix. :thumbsup:
eng-oncall: Logged ENG-5043, will instrument h2 window utilization and auth-cache hit/miss telemetry. Assigning to eng-runtime.
mike_sre: Temporary runbook note: if 502 spike observed, try: 1) force route to dedicated warm pool via header x-rd-route=warm 2) throttle billing writes to 5/s 3) roll auth cache TTL to 60s for tenant.
support-rami: Marking customer informed, monitoring for rollback. Closing interim escalation, will update when ENG-5043 has root cause. :white_check_mark:
